verdict.rationale: Factory ships an official Droid CLI. It is documented with a quickstart for installation and interactive sessions, slash commands, MCP tools, Missions, and a headless `droid exec` mode for CI/CD with structured input and output formats, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI beyond first-party docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use the Droid CLI to run Factory from your terminal, editor, tests, and Git workflow.
It gives the same Factory runtime through an interactive terminal UI with project context, approvals, MCP tools, Missions, and headless execution.
droid exec runs in scripts and CI/CD pipelines with structured input and output formats.
Use this quickstart to install the Droid CLI, start an interactive terminal session, and delegate a first scoped task.
